Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording for this one, but you can note that I was the driver of the vehicle
involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened and what the weather and road conditions were like?
A: It was on a two-lane road in League City, Texas. It was daylight and dry. Traffic was light.
Q: Walk me through what happened right before impact.
A: I was heading in my lane and the other car came over the center line. I braked and steered right, but we still met
nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me forward and then back into the seat.
Q: What was your speed at the time?
A: I'd guess around twenty-five miles an hour. I wasn't going fast.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. My seatbelt was on and I think that's why I stayed fairly upright.
Q: How are you feeling now?
A: Not great. I have a headache that won't go away, I feel foggy, and bright lights bother my eyes. My doctor has told
me I have a concussion and I'm supposed to limit screen time and rest.
Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?
A: Yes, I was seen at an urgent care clinic the same day and I've had a follow-up since.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm still dealing with symptoms and I'm trying to keep track of them in a journal. I'll send it over if you need
it.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
</page>
